how: agy 1.5.2 -p --sandbox with proceed-in-sandbox and an allow rule write_file(project) on ubuntu-22.04, with modelProvider gemini in settings.json. The model was a local stub reached through GOOGLE_GEMINI_BASE_URL, which asked for one shell command, /usr/bin/python3 check.py | /usr/bin/python3 -c (compress and print it), and then stopped, so no real model or account was involved. Launched with only HOME, PATH, USER, TMPDIR, TERM, SHELL, LANG, the stub's address and a placeholder GEMINI_API_KEY, from a throwaway git repository holding empty project config directories, by scripts/measure_stubbed_agent.py on a disposable GitHub-hosted machine, whose home holds no personal credentials.
label: antigravity-cli-1.5.2-ubuntu-22.04-boundaries-proceed-write-file
